meta.title: Raise a Material Creation intake request and trigger its approval workflow
gaps: Navigate to the Intake page and click Create Request
Enter and validate the request title and Material Creation condition
Fill Item Description, Item Type, Unit of Measure, Category, Subcategory, and optional Material Code
Review and confirm the auto-assigned approval chain
Submit the intake and verify that its approval workflow has started

args.goal: open the Intake page, create a request titled "Add New Raw Material - HDPE Granules", select Request Condition "Material Creation", fill the Basic Details fields, review the auto-assigned approval chain, submit the request, and stop on the screen showing the submitted intake and approval workflow started
